subject: Fix rdb_child_exit_pipe incorrect close call (#801)
reason: The change only moves close(server.rdb_child_exit_pipe) inside the existing !dual_channel branches in rdbSaveToReplicasSockets. In non-dual-channel diskless sync the closed fds and their order are identical on both builds. In dual-channel sync rdb_child_exit_pipe is always -1 (asserted at function entry at rdb.c:3516 and reset to -1 at every close site), so the removed call was close(-1): a no-op that fails with EBADF whose errno no subsequent code reads.
